matter_name: Pellegrino Capital Group — Co-Investment in Ridgeline-Clarion Co-Invest, L.P.
matter_description: Representation of Pellegrino Capital Group LLC in connection with its $25,000,000 co-investment alongside Ridgeline Equity Partners Fund IV, L.P. in Ridgeline-Clarion Co-Invest, L.P., a Delaware co-investment vehicle formed to acquire Clarion Hospitality Holdings, Inc., including negotiation of the Co-Invest LPA, a side letter, and a subscription agreement, plus related tax analysis and closing deliverables.
matter_type: fund co-investment / private equity LP-side representation

key_deadlines.what: Anticipated closing date (6-8 weeks from engagement letter; matches Closing Date defined in Co-Invest LPA)

billing.budget: $175,000-$250,000 estimated total fees (non-binding estimate, not a cap), exclusive of disbursements

status.basis: The Amended and Restated LPA of Ridgeline-Clarion Co-Invest, L.P. is an 'Execution Version' dated as of January 30, 2026, with 'Closing Date' defined therein as January 30, 2026, indicating the co-investment closed; no separate post-closing/closing-confirmation letter to Pellegrino is among the sources, so the closed status is inferred from the executed transaction document rather than a firm closing letter.

governing_law: Delaware (Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act, 6 Del. C. § 17-101 et seq., governs the Co-Invest LPA); Florida Rules of Professional Conduct govern the engagement letter

deal_or_case.transaction_value: $25,000,000 (Pellegrino's commitment) of $75,000,000 aggregate Co-Invest Vehicle commitments, within a $250,000,000 total AcquisitionCo equity capitalization (Fund IV committing $175,000,000)

significant_events.what: Stock Purchase Agreement for the Acquisition dated
Closing Date / Execution Version of Amended and Restated Co-Invest LPA dated
